svg.title: AUTHORIZATION: RBAC, ABAC, REBAC: sketchnote
svg.text: Authentication asks who you are. Authorization asks whether you may do this.
RBAC: roles grant permissions. ABAC: policy over attributes.
ReBAC: paths in a relationship graph (Zanzibar).
Gateway authenticates; the service that owns the resource
asks check(user, action, resource); deny by default; audit.
RBAC: a few coarse roles, admin consoles
One check per item when listing
One policy source, not scattered ifs
Cache with invalidation or consistency tokens
Lookup APIs to list what a user can see
Log every decision on sensitive data
teams and users are tuples, the docs service calls
check(user, view, doc) on every read with a short
cache, admins are an RBAC role, and decisions are
